tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List the model categories available in NovAI's price feed (Chat / LLM, Video, Image, Audio, 3D, Embedding) with the number of models in each. Use this first when the category for a request is unclear, then call cheapest_models with that category. Machine-readable feed: https://aiapi-pro.com/china-ai
